verdict.rationale: Skills package workflows that Claude runs over user data. The repo explicitly cites 'analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows' (gh-9), and a pre-built xlsx skill runs in the code execution environment (docs-10, docs-11). A hands-on report says the xlsx skill handles many Excel edge cases well (comm-8). However, any insights come from Claude using a skill the user authors or installs, not from a built-in data-insights feature. Community reports also say skills often fail to auto-trigger without explicit invocation (comm-12, comm-14). Missing for 10: a documented first-party data-analysis or insight-generation skill, examples of proactive suggestions drawn from user data, and independent corroboration that insights are actually produced.
